description: This file defines the CatalogFragment class, a UI component in an Android app that displays a list of products, supports filtering by category, search queries, and sorting. It manages user interactions, rendering of product list, and filtering logic.

classes.name: CatalogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays product listings with filtering, sorting, and search capabilities.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up product list, filters, sorting, and search debounce logic.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up pending search callbacks when view is destroyed.

methods.name: setupDebouncedSearch
methods.description: Sets up a debounced search input listener to reduce frequent refreshes.

methods.name: setupSortDropdown
methods.description: Configures sorting options dropdown and its selection handler.

methods.name: renderCategoryFilters
methods.description: Populates category filter chips in the UI.

methods.name: refreshProducts
methods.description: Refreshes the product list based on current filters and sorting.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Filters products based on selected category and search query.

methods.name: applySorting
methods.description: Sorts products according to selected sorting option.

methods.name: matchesSearch
methods.description: Checks if a product matches the current search query by name or category.

methods.name: relevanceScore
methods.description: Calculates a relevance score for in-memory product ranking based on search query.
